Name: Hedge Knight
Notes: Shield-wall type - Guarded's own stand-still Bad Luck bonus plus Durable's Protected regen make it a slow, reliable damage-soak: only 1 attack a turn, but consistently hard to crack rather than a burst threat. Drafted alongside 4 other Level 1 archetypes specifically to mix up Fighting Styles (not every enemy on Flurry) - see design/enemy_sim/README.md and combat_sim.py's own docstring. DamageBonus=3/AccuracyBonus=-2/DefenseBonus=-2 (enemy_builder's own ability_dmg_bonus/ability_acc_bonus/ability_def_bonus, not the shared tunables.DMG_RESIST/ACCURACY curves) supersede an earlier DamageBonus=4-only calibration for this 5-archetype set once win rate was checked against the real make_party(1) baseline (run_grid.py's own official method) rather than assumed: that first pass turned out to land nowhere near the intended on-level win rate once actually measured (an early exploratory pass of this same retune also briefly used AccuracyBonus=-4, but that sweep was built without wiring in each archetype's own BattleTactic/FightingStyle - Guarded, Durable, Assassin targeting, Flurry - so it wasn't fighting with its real behavior; re-checked with the real mechanics active, -2 is the closer match). DefenseBonus (a shared retune to Parry/Dodge/Bodily/Mental together) turned out to be the cleanest of the three levers for hitting a target win rate and a target 'HP% remaining on a win' at the same time - it changes how fast the party kills the enemy, not how hard the enemy hits back, so it moves those two numbers together instead of trading one for the other the way Damage/Accuracy alone do. This combination lands at win~69%, ~4.7 rounds average, ~68% party HP remaining on a win, against tunables.HEALTH_BASE[1]=8 (was 7) - see design/enemy_sim/README.md's own entry for the full sweep.
